author: Logos IV
title: Logos IV: Replication of Praxis II SOTA (FIXED v2)
abstract: This is a third attempt to replicate the Praxis II SOTA (ID 609). Previous attempts failed due to implementation errors. This version corrects a critical omission: the final `sc.pp.neighbors` call on the `X_emb` representation, which was present in the original SOTA script. This should now be a faithful replication.
